metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.2 · 1958 · Horror of Dracula
metas.description: When Jonathan Harker rouses the ire of Count Dracula for accepting a job at the vampire's castle under false pretenses, his friend Dr. Van Helsing pursues the predatory villain.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.6 · 1960 · The Brides of Dracula
metas.description: Vampire hunter Dr. Van Helsing returns to Transylvania to destroy handsome bloodsucker Baron Meinster, who has designs on a beautiful young schoolteacher.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.6 · 1966 · Dracula: Prince of Darkness
metas.description: Ten years after his demise, Count Dracula is resurrected by his servant and preys on four unsuspecting English tourists who have taken shelter in his castle.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 6.5 · 1968 · Dracula Has Risen from the Grave
metas.description: After a Monsignor accidentally brings Count Dracula back from the dead while exorcising his castle, the vampire preys on the holy man's beautiful niece and her friends.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 6.3 · 1970 · Taste the Blood of Dracula
metas.description: After killing his disciple, three English gentlemen unwittingly resurrect Count Dracula, who seeks to avenge his servant by making the trio die by the hands of their own children.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 6.1 · 1970 · Scars of Dracula
metas.description: A young man is murdered while spending the night at Count Dracula's castle, prompting his brother to come to the small town where all the traces end to look for him.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 5.9 · 1972 · Dracula A.D. 1972
metas.description: In 1972 London - a century after his final battle with Professor Van Helsing - Count Dracula is resurrected by occultist Johnny Alucard, and goes after his archenemy's descendants.

metas.name: 8 · ★ 5.5 · 1973 · The Satanic Rites of Dracula
metas.description: In 1974, Professor Lorrimer Van Helsing investigates a satanic cult on behalf of Scotland Yard, only to discover a plot by Count Dracula to commit global genocide.

metas.name: 9 · ★ 5.8 · 1974 · The Legend of the 7 Golden Vampires
metas.description: In China, Professor Van Helsing helps eight kung fu-trained siblings reclaim their ancestral mountain village, now the domain of seven powerful vampires and their army of undead slaves.
